claim_boundaries.constructed_center_not_observed_centroid: The centered coordinates use only an algebraic origin reconstructed from edge vectors. They are not observed or human-labeled object centroids, scene centers, camera centers or recovered physical positions.
claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The inherited constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic reference, not recovered fixture truth, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.exactness_domain: Exact means equality over rational interpretations of pinned finite binary floating-point values. It does not authenticate source precision, physical truth, uncertainty or measurement accuracy.
claim_boundaries.no_invariance_or_spectral_claim: No square root or eigendecomposition is performed. No coordinate/frame or translation invariance, principal direction, eigenvalue, conditioning, degeneracy, angle, similarity, acceptance or representation ranking is claimed.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_endpoint: Rows have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0,rhat,r and answer neither A7 nor any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.scatter_not_physical_variance_or_inertia: Squared coordinate norms and their sum describe frozen residual vectors. They are not physical scatter, variance, inertia, distance, length, image footprint, silhouette, visible area or metric quality; no statistical variance or population moment is estimated.
claim_boundaries.science_annotation_and_release: No raw bytes, labels, manifest, annotation eligibility, inference, forecast metric, current-state claim, stage gate, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: The three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population, representation or camera effect is estimated.

construction_semantics.centered_coordinate_formulas: The exact algebraic centroid origin gives a_c=(eAB+eAC)/3, b_c=(-2*eAB+eAC)/3 and c_c=(eAB-2*eAC)/3.
construction_semantics.edge_reconstruction: The audit verifies a_c-b_c=eAB,a_c-c_c=eAC and b_c-c_c=eBC component by component over exact rationals.
construction_semantics.excluded_operations: No square root, eigendecomposition, normalization, tolerance, threshold, classification, fitting, registration or ranking is performed.
construction_semantics.fixed_order: A=banana,B=bowl,C=rubiks_cube with eAB=A-B,eAC=A-C,eBC=B-C. No object, operand, coordinate, camera or source-row reordering occurs.
construction_semantics.stored_coordinate_domain: Each finite source edge coordinate is interpreted as its exact binary floating-point rational value. Integer numerator/denominator strings control equality; approximate numbers are display aids only.
construction_semantics.units_and_scope: World coordinate/scalar records use stored m/m^2 units; projected records use stored px/px^2 units. These are residual-vector-space coordinate identities, not physical or image-object measurements.

finding: All 9 world and 36 projected retained residual-triangle rows have exact zero centered-coordinate sums, exact pairwise edge reconstruction and zero Huygens residual. The package serializes 1,008 exact rational records and revalidates all 504 Turn2853 exact records. This is a deterministic stored-coordinate algebra check only, not physical or scientific evidence.
